item.title: Along 4 the Hike: Genesee County Park and Forest
item.description: BETHANY, N.Y. (WIVB) – The scenery at Genesee County Park and Forest in East Bethany includes numerous snow-covered bridges and snowy paths framed by trees in the winter. Even with the snow now melting away, it’s always a great place to spend some time outdoors.
